related_questions.question: How many days after a COVID fever are you contagious?

text_blocks.snippet: People with COVID-19 are typically most contagious when symptoms peak, which is often around day four of symptoms. While contagiousness decreases over time, individuals can remain contagious for an average of eight days, according to a study from Yale New Haven Hospital. Transmission can occur 1-2 days before symptoms even begin.

list.title: Peak Contagiousness:
list.snippet: For most respiratory viruses, including COVID-19, contagiousness peaks when symptoms are at their worst, which, for COVID-19, is often around day four of symptoms.

list.title: Overall Contagious Period:
list.snippet: People with COVID-19 can be contagious for an average of 8 days, with this period potentially varying based on individual factors like health conditions and illness severity.

list.title: Pre-Symptomatic Transmission:
list.snippet: It's also important to note that people can be contagious 1-2 days before they even experience symptoms, meaning they can spread the virus before they realize they are infected.
